label: Drought
title: Rainfall compared with normal
subtitle: Jun 2026 to Aug 2026
how: Each district shows its rainfall over the latest 3 months, compared with the same months in every year from 1991 to 2020. A district is "very dry" when this year is among the driest 10% of those years, "dry" when among the driest 30%, and the same in reverse for "wet" and "very wet".
limits: This is a rainfall indicator. It does not measure crop damage, river levels or groundwater.
The rainfall estimate blends satellite and rain-gauge data on a grid of about 5 km. It suits district averages, not individual farms.
When the normal rainfall for the period is under 30 mm, the district is shown as "dry season" and not rated, because small differences would look like large percentages.
The map has not been checked against ground reports. Treat it as a guide, not an official drought declaration.

credits.text: Rainfall: CHIRPS, Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara
